physical_standard_test.male: Height: 157.5 cm (relaxed by 5 cms for Garhwalis, Assamese, Gorkhas and members of ST); Chest: 81 cm (fully expanded with min expansion 5 cm)
physical_standard_test.female: Height: 152 cm (relaxed by 2.5 cms for specified categories); Weight: 48 kg (relaxed by 2 kg for ST)

General Central Service Group 'C' Non-Gazetted, Non-Ministerial

eligibility_criteria.nationality: Citizen of India / Subject of Nepal / Bhutan
eligibility_criteria.age_limit: 18-25 years for MTS and Havaldar in CBN; 18-27 years for Havaldar in CBIC (Customs & Central Excise) and few MTS posts. (OBC +3 yrs, SC/ST +5 yrs)
eligibility_criteria.educational_qualification: Must have passed Matriculation (10th Class) Examination or equivalent from a recognized Board.
